text: Grok — quoting @SpaceX VP of Launch: Grok is now helping identify foreign object debris in aerospace parts; Grok (99.9%) is better at it than humans (94%).
zh: 马斯克：转发SpaceX发射副总裁的说法——Grok已用于识别航天零件中的异物碎片，准确率99.9%，高于人工的94%。

text: President Trump delivers an update following a meeting with the Prime Minister of Qatar regarding the historically successful Naval Blockade against Iran. "At the conclusion of the military engagement, the American people and the people of the world will be far safer."
zh: 白宫：特朗普在会见卡塔尔首相后就对伊朗的海上封锁发表最新讲话，称军事行动结束后，美国人民和全世界都将更安全。

text: We built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across our research infrastructure and stop them quickly when safety or security concerns arise.
zh: OpenAI：推出“Control Room”中央系统，用于跟踪研究基础设施中的模型工作负载，出现安全问题时可迅速叫停。

text: "Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, and others, would prefer the status quo, in other words, a continuation of the Greatest Naval Blockade in History, and the new Operation Iron Gate — Therefore, Land and Sea." - President Donald J. Trump
zh: 白宫：特朗普称卡塔尔、沙特、阿联酋、巴林、科威特等国更愿维持现状，即继续史上最大规模海上封锁以及新的“铁门行动”，陆海并进。

text: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 are available now
zh: Anthropic：Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2 现已上线，编码、推理和视觉能力均有提升。

text: Four distinct TPU systems in a single generation in one year!
zh: 皮查伊：谷歌一年内在单代产品中推出四种不同的TPU系统，硬件工程师与DeepMind协同设计，无需等待传统半导体周期。

text: We're recruiting a new class of astronauts, making major advancements on the Moon Base, and challenging students to a $1 million design competition.
zh: NASA：宣布招募新一批宇航员、推进月球基地建设，并发起100万美元的学生设计竞赛。

text: Project Crystal Sun — quoting @Tesla: Tesla has officially started construction of its massive new $10 billion solar manufacturing facility near Houston, Texas! Construction expected to finish in 2028, commercial operations Q1 2029.
zh: 马斯克：转发特斯拉消息——特斯拉已正式开工建设休斯敦附近价值100亿美元的大型太阳能制造工厂，预计2028年完工、2029年一季度投产（“水晶太阳计划”）。

text: Three years of the Zero Debris Charter! More than 250 signatories from 36 countries are now working towards a zero debris future by 2030.
zh: 欧洲航天局:「零碎片宪章」迎来三周年,已有来自36个国家的250多个签署方,正朝着2030年实现零太空碎片的目标推进,技术目标有望达成。

text: The Cybertruck order rate far exceeds our production rate. We will try to make as many as possible before shutting down the line in about 8 months, but will have to return deposits for a lot of people. This is not a case of Cybertruck being unprofitable, as has been misreported
zh: 马斯克:Cybertruck 的订单速度远超产能,约8个月后将停掉这条产线,期间会尽量多造,但不得不向很多人退还定金;并称这并不是 Cybertruck 不赚钱,外界的报道有误。

text: Today, @Rebellions_inc, @SKtelecom and @NVIDIA announced a collaboration to advance sovereign AI infrastructure with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion.
zh: 英伟达新闻室:Rebellions、SK电信与英伟达宣布合作,借助NVLink Fusion推进主权AI基础设施建设,称主权AI需要芯片、基础设施、模型和服务整套协同。

text: Excited to be working with @Qualcomm on breakthrough technologies for 5G & beyond — quoting @SpaceX news: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon says the partnership will be one of the largest 5G deployments in the US; SpaceX builds the base stations, Qualcomm provides the silicon.
zh: 马斯克：很高兴与高通合作研发 5G 及更先进技术——转引高通 CEO 阿蒙称，这将是美国最大的 5G 部署之一，SpaceX 负责建基站，高通提供芯片。

text: Just did a round table review with the Grok @Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight and you should notice a dramatic improvement by tomorrow.
zh: 马斯克：刚与 Grok Bot 工程团队开了圆桌评审，修复将在夜间落地，预计明天就能明显感到改善；若没有，请回复该帖，会立即处理。

text: Task Force Iron Gate is in full force and effect in the Islamic Republic of Iran.
zh: 白宫：“铁门特遣队”已在伊朗全面生效。

text: We just issued a press release from our board of directors.
zh: 英伟达：公司刚发布了一份来自董事会的新闻稿。

text: Larry Page has made many accurate predictions and this is one of them — quoting: Larry Page reportedly said how much compute will be orbital: five nines (99.999%).
zh: 马斯克：拉里·佩奇做过很多准确预测，这是其中之一——转引称佩奇认为未来轨道算力占比将达“五个9”（99.999%）。

text: Just announced at MAX POWER: a $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge!
zh: NASA：在 MAX POWER 航展上宣布设立100万美元的“月球基地学生挑战赛”，面向美国高中和高校学生团队。

text: "I will be interviewed tonight on '60 Minutes.' ... If we get help from the Republican Senate, we can still do things that are unbelievable!" - President Trump
zh: 白宫：特朗普称今晚将接受《60分钟》采访，若得到共和党参议院的支持，仍能做成不可思议的事。

text: Grok Bot fixes for improved token efficiency and smarter behavior are underway
zh: 马斯克：Grok Bot 针对提升 token 效率和更智能表现的修复正在进行中。
